# Example article about checklists

An example article on what makes checklists work: keep them short, use them at a pause point, and pick the list type to fit the team and the task. It also names a tool that keeps lists as plain text.

## Key points
- Short lists of five to nine items, read aloud at a pause point, work best.
- Do-confirm lists suit experienced teams; read-do lists suit rare tasks.
- An example checklist tool keeps lists as plain text files.

<!-- private -->
- The owner noted trying a pause-point checklist for the example household budget review.
